meta.title: 液面不干净，怎么办？掌握好这点轻松解决！
meta.title_en: Dirty Surface? Master This One Point and It's Solved!
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 液面干净

scenes.context: 流距过高：冲击力击穿液面导致反白。奶缸抬得太高，牛奶冲击力击穿液面，液面发白不干净。语域：咖啡教学，问题演示。
sentences: 流距过高，冲击力击穿液面。
Pouring from too high pierces the surface.
pierces the surface（击穿液面）
击穿后，液面反白。
After piercing, the surface turns white.
turns white（反白）
液面不干净，就是这个原因。
That's why the surface looks dirty.
looks dirty（不干净）
paraphrase: 流距 → pouring height / the gap
击穿液面 → pierce the surface / break through
scenes.speak: Pouring from too high pierces the surface. After piercing, the surface turns white. That's why the surface looks dirty.

scenes.title_en: Too Low: White Spots and Threads
scenes.context: 流距过低：奶泡浮在表面形成白点和白丝。奶缸太低，奶泡浮在液面上形成白点和白丝。语域：咖啡教学，对比演示。
sentences: 流距过低，奶泡浮在表面。
Too low, and the foam floats on the surface.
floats on the surface（浮在表面）
形成白点和白丝。
It forms white spots and threads.
white threads（白丝）
高度不对，液面就不干净。
Wrong height, dirty surface.
wrong height（高度不对）
paraphrase: 奶泡浮面 → foam floats / milk froth on top
白点白丝 → white spots and threads / speckles
scenes.speak: Too low, and the foam floats on the surface. It forms white spots and threads. Wrong height, dirty surface.

scenes.title_en: Low to High: Stabilize First, Then Rise
scenes.context: 由低到高：先稳定再拉高，融合干净。正确做法是先低流距融合，稳定后再慢慢拉高，液面才干净。语域：咖啡教学，正确示范。
sentences: 由低到高，先稳定再拉高。
Go low to high: stabilize first, then rise.
stabilize first（先稳定）
融合干净，液面才干净。
A clean blend means a clean surface.
a clean blend（融合干净）
掌握流距，问题就解决了。
Master the height and the problem is solved.
master the height（掌握流距）
paraphrase: 先稳定再拉高 → stabilize then rise / steady, then lift
stabilize then rise · steady then lift
融合干净 → a clean blend / well-integrated
scenes.speak: Go low to high: stabilize first, then rise. A clean blend means a clean surface. Master the height and the problem is solved.

practice: Pouring from too high pierces the surface.
Too low, and the foam floats on the surface.
Go low to high: stabilize first, then rise.
pitfalls: Pouring from too high pierces the surface.
It forms white spots and threads.
「白点白丝」用 white spots and threads。
Go low to high: stabilize first, then rise.
「由低到高」用 go low to high。
That's why the surface looks dirty.
shifts: 用 pouring height（流距）、pierces the surface（击穿液面）、stabilize first（先稳定）
用 turns white（反白）、white spots and threads（白点白丝）、a clean blend（干净融合）
用 master the height（掌握流距）、wrong height（高度不对）、well-integrated（融合好）
